items.title: Better language models and their implications
items.summary: We’ve trained a large-scale unsupervised language model which generates coherent paragraphs of text, achieves state-of-the-art performance on many language modeling benchmarks, and performs rudimentary reading comprehension, machine translation, question answering, and summarization—all without task-specific training.
items.summaryZh: 本文来自OpenAI，围绕“Better language models and their implications”介绍评测榜单方面的最新进展，重点涉及Benchmark。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
